# Introduction  

Detect doublets from scATAC-seq data using [ArchR](https://www.archrproject.com/bookdown/inferring-scatac-seq-doublets-with-archr.html) 

# Library 

```{r}
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ArchR)
library(stringr)
library(parallel)
```

# Parameters

```{r}
here::dr_here(show_reason = TRUE)

patient <- params$patient
subproj <- params$subproj

source(here::here(glue::glue("{subproj}/multiome_analysis/misc/paths.R")))
source(here::here("utils/bin.R"))

"{qc}/{robj_dir}/doublet_projects/{patient}" %>%
  glue::glue() %>%
  here::here() %>%
  dir.create(path = .,
             showWarnings = FALSE,
             recursive = TRUE)
set.seed(0)
```

# Load data

```{r}
seurat_obj <- readRDS(here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/2.2_{patient}.rds")))
```

# Create arrowfile and project

```{r eval=F, include=F}
frag_path <- Fragments(seurat_obj@assays$ATAC)[[1]]@path
spl <- strsplit(frag_path, "/")
half_fp <- paste(spl[[1]][6:length(spl[[1]])], collapse="/")
inputFiles <- paste0("/scratch_isilon/groups/singlecell/isentis", half_fp)
```

```{r eval=T}
seurat_obj <- change_frag_path(seurat_obj, "ATAC")
inputFiles <- Fragments(seurat_obj@assays$ATAC)[[1]]@path
names(inputFiles) <- patient
```

```{r eval=T}
addArchRGenome("hg38")
addArchRThreads(threads = 10) 
```

```{r eval=T}
ArrowFiles <- createArrowFiles(
  inputFiles = inputFiles,
  sampleNames = names(inputFiles),
  minTSS = 1, #Dont set this too high because you can always increase later
  minFrags = 1000, 
  addTileMat = TRUE,
  addGeneScoreMat = TRUE,
  excludeChr = c("chrM", "chrY")
)
```


Create an ArchR project with the arrow files
```{r eval=T}
ArrowFiles <- glue::glue("{patient}.arrow")
out_dir <- here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/doublet_projects/{patient}"))

pj <- ArchRProject(
  ArrowFiles = ArrowFiles, 
  outputDirectory = out_dir,
  copyArrows = TRUE # This is recommended so that if you modify the Arrow files you have an original copy for later usage.
)
```

# Filter low quality cells

```{r include=F, eval=F}
pj <- loadArchRProject(here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/doublet_projects/{patient}")))
```


Filter cells that have already been filtered before (keep good quality cell barcodes from Seurat)
```{r eval=T}
bc <- colnames(seurat_obj)
bc <- paste(patient, bc, sep="#")
bc_p <- rownames(getCellColData(pj))
table(bc %in% bc_p)
```

```{r eval=T}
bc <- bc[bc %in% bc_p]
pj_filt <- pj[bc, ]
```


# Estimate doublets

```{r eval=T}
pj_filt <- addDoubletScores(
  input = pj_filt,
  k = 10, # Refers to how many cells near a "pseudo-doublet" to count.
  knnMethod = "UMAP", # Refers to the embedding to use for nearest neighbor search.
  LSIMethod = 1)
```

```{r eval=T}
df_dbl <- getCellColData(pj_filt)

df_dbl <- df_dbl %>%  
  data.frame %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("barcodes")
```

# Save

```{r eval=T}
write_csv(df_dbl, path = here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/doublet_projects/{patient}/dbl_archr.csv")))
```

```{r eval=T}
out_dir <- here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/doublet_projects/{patient}"))
saveArchRProject(
  ArchRProj = pj_filt,
  outputDirectory = out_dir,
  load = FALSE,
  dropCells = TRUE)
```

```{r eval=T}
# move intermediate folders to corresponding arch project
out_list <- Sys.glob(file.path(here::here("scripts/multiome"), glue::glue("QualityControl")))
print(length(out_list))
for (f in out_list) {
  splited <- str_split(f, "/")[[1]]
  filename <- rev(splited)[1]
  file.rename(f,
             here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/doublet_projects/{patient}/{filename}"))) 
}
```

```{r eval=T}
# move intermediate folders to corresponding arch project
out_list <- Sys.glob(file.path(here::here("scripts/multiome"), glue::glue("ArchRLogs")))
print(length(out_list))
for (f in out_list) {
  splited <- str_split(f, "/")[[1]]
  filename <- rev(splited)[1]
  file.rename(f,
             here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/doublet_projects/{patient}/{filename}"))) 
}
```

# Add information to metadata

```{r include=T, eval=T}
df_dbl <- read_csv(here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/doublet_projects/{patient}/dbl_archr.csv")))
```

```{r include=T, eval=T}
df_dbl <- df_dbl %>% 
  mutate(orig.barcode = gsub(glue::glue("{patient}#"), "", barcodes)) 

df_meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
df_meta$orig.barcode <- rownames(df_meta)

df_meta <- merge(df_meta, df_dbl, all=TRUE)
```

```{r include=T, eval=T}
sum(is.na(df_meta$DoubletScore))
```

```{r include=T, eval=T}
seurat_obj@meta.data$doublet_score_atac <- df_meta$DoubletScore
seurat_obj@meta.data$doublet_enrichment_atac <- df_meta$DoubletEnrichment
```

```{r fig.height = 6, fig.width = 14, out.width = "100%", include=F, eval=F}
FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, 
            features = c("doublet_score_atac", "doublet_score"), 
            reduction = "umap.atac", ncol=2)
```

```{r fig.height = 6, fig.width = 14, out.width = "100%", include=F, eval=F}
FeaturePlot(seurat_obj, 
            features = c("doublet_score_atac", "doublet_score"), 
            reduction = "wnn.umap", ncol=2)
```

```{r fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8, out.width = "100%",  include=F, eval=F}
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "wnn.umap", label = T) + NoLegend()
```

```{r fig.height = 6, fig.width = 8, out.width = "100%",  include=F, eval=F}
DimPlot(seurat_obj, reduction = "umap.atac", label = T) + NoLegend()
```

```{r include=T, eval=T}
saveRDS(seurat_obj, here::here(glue::glue("{qc}/{robj_dir}/2.3_{patient}.rds")))
```
